title: Sam & Layla — Ep. 1 — P04: Plan F: more sun / the one-star review / 'I'll watch it'
summary: A giant magnifying glass almost toasts the seed. Sam googles it and gives nature one star. He sits down to watch.

lines.text: Plan F. More sun. *Way* more sun.
lines.tts: [scheming] Plan F. More sun. Way more sun.
lines.note: He holds a giant magnifying glass over the mound; a bright dot of light; a curl of smoke.
He flaps at it. Layla calmly pours her water bottle on it: sizzle, steam.
Layla's flat stare. He hides the glass behind his back.
MCU: phone in hand, screen glow on his face.

lines.text: How... to grow... a tree... fast.
lines.tts: [reading aloud slowly while typing] How... to grow... a tree... fast.

lines.note: Speech bubble pops with one filled star, four empty.

lines.tts: [scandalised] Step two: be more patient?! [shouting] ...Zero stars!
lines.note: Bubble: all five stars empty, one star falls off.

lines.text: Fine. I'll sit right here... and *watch* it.
lines.tts: [stubborn] Fine. I'll sit right here... and watch it.
lines.note: WS: stomps to the rock, sits (CMU 13_01), arms crossed, staring at the mound.

beats: OPEN (0-2.6 s): Sam strides in with a giant magnifying glass, sunglasses on.
HOLD: the staring contest begins — he sits on the rock, arms crossed; clock ticks; a fly lands on his nose; he doesn't blink.
